decisions.finding: Six historical raw records have an explicit needs_verification hold and no independently bound global identity/translation evidence in the audited records. Homepage additionally published conflicting Chinese aliases for the first three.
decisions.action: Keep raw records byte-identical for traceability. Public directory/detail/summary/metadata now use a localized legacy-entry label and literal URL key, never a substitute official identity.

decisions.finding: Generic Character mapping promoted raw attribute/rarity and a default international release label. Core registry retains 12 elements and three rarity options; these are legacy site configuration, not evidence of game implementation.
decisions.action: Withdraw generic international character roster to an explicit empty array. Public projection exposes only ID and editorial review marker; web adapters expose no element or rarity. Leave registry byte-identical; international tool and rating consumers stay empty. CN stays unchanged and is not newly fact-verified.

decisions.finding: Image helper assembled a per-ID asset URL; local public directory contains only three of six matching files. Filename/existence/hash does not establish artwork identity, provenance, licensing, or CDN availability.
decisions.action: Do not request or display old artwork on character cards/details, metadata or featured homepage. Use text placeholders only. Compatibility image helper returns empty string; avatar handles absent source without an image request. Keep existing asset files intact, not rights-cleared.

decisions.finding: Six detailed metadata overrides still held unsupported starter/wild identity, habitat, evolution and behavior claims behind a review branch.
decisions.action: Archive full original shared source and remove those six overrides. Remove homepage featured Roco records. Retain all other game mappings.

Six known IDs retain three-language 200/self-canonical/noindex-follow/no hreflang correction pages. Unknown IDs and extra segments remain 404. Character directory remains readable and indexable; expected sitemap set is unchanged. Search manifests already exclude roco.

limitations: No new official global identity evidence or asset usage permission obtained; withdrawal is not verification, cancellation evidence, or proof of nonexistence.

Original held raw source and public raw mirror remain unchanged, including historical fields and explicit review markers; direct raw access is not a verified roster. This batch does not claim all public/raw facts or direct asset URLs have been removed.

Legacy asset URLs remain accessible if the static server serves them; physical deletion/quarantine or licensing permission needs a separate approved plan. Local fixture cannot establish CDN identity, availability or rights.
Historical rocoCharacters/getRocoCharacterById/getRocoCharacterDescription compatibility source access remains; current public consumers have been redirected to a field-limited review projection.
Two factual holds stay open with unchanged semantic hashes and approval bindings. No cloud/production validation or all-owner acceptance.
Legacy IndexNow scripts still list historical/noindex character URLs; not executed. Submission-policy consolidation is a separate bounded follow-up, not evidence of live submission.
Other Roco item/redeem-code aggregations and inaccessible old game-home copy still need consumer review; Genshin migration and storage governance are separate work.
